name: AS214205
notes:
AS214205 is a non-commercial, community-driven network providing free IPv6 transit and tunnelbroker services to non-commercial actors — NGOs, personal ASNs, and students who do not have easy access to transit. The project is educational in nature, helping enthusiasts and small organizations build their own infrastructure and learn real-world BGP routing, while lowering the barrier to entry into the global routing ecosystem.

The network operates PoPs in Frankfurt, Amsterdam, the United Kingdom, and Romania, announcing its own IPv6 prefixes via AS214205. We maintain an open peering policy and welcome peering requests at any of our locations, as well as at the IXPs where we are present.

For peering or any inquiries, please reach out via the contact details below.
